smoking.disclaimer: General information, not medical advice. Everyone's body is different.

items.text: Heart rate and blood pressure drop.
Carbon monoxide level in your blood drops to normal.
Circulation improves and lung function increases.
Coughing and shortness of breath decrease.
Risk of coronary heart disease is about half that of a smoker's.
Stroke risk is reduced to that of a non-smoker.
Lung cancer risk falls to about half that of a smoker; risk of mouth, throat, esophagus, bladder, cervix and pancreas cancer decreases.
Risk of coronary heart disease is that of a non-smoker's.
